item.title: About
item.description: My name is William Jongeward, though I like the sound and brevity of Will Jonge. I am from Southern California, graduated from UCSD, served two years in the Peace Corps in Timor-Leste, traveled a year around Asia and the Americas, and currently live in New York City. The purpose of this website is to serve as a collection of my photos, stories, and ideas. Maybe I can’t be the most interesting person in the world, but I can be one of the most interested. Whether it is by traveling, reading, or talking to strangers at bus stops, I hope I can fill my life with as much understanding of the world as possible. May this site serve as a useful conduit from what I experience, to my personal absractions, to your hopeful enjoyment.
